description.en: Creates a low-detail cutscene model looked up by a specific event-character ID (a model variant reserved for a particular event), rather than by generic face/body numbers or NPC number.
Name to assign the created model.
Event-character ID identifying which model to create.
Optional flag passed through to CMND_CREATE_CHARA (defaults to false).
Optional memory pool to allocate the model from (defaults to DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail model for a specific event-character ID
local hEvChr = CreateEvLowMdlForEventChrID("evChrL", "evc0001");
